info.name: Fitness Center - Flutter POS API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the Fitness Center Flutter POS mobile app.

## Setup
1. Set the `base_url` variable to your app URL (e.g. `https://fitness-center.test`).
2. Run the **Login** request first — it auto-saves the token.
3. All authenticated requests use `{{token}}` from the collection variables.

## Variables
- `base_url` — Your app base URL
- `token` — Sanctum bearer token (auto-set on login)
- `uuid` — Reusable UUID placeholder
